description: This file contains the implementation of the FooTable plugin's editing component, including class definitions, methods for managing editing UI, event handling, and integration with other FooTable modules like paging and sorting.

classes.name: F.Editing
classes.description: The main class implementing the editing UI component, managing buttons, events, and configuration.

classes.name: F.EditingColumn
classes.description: Represents the editing column in the table, containing edit/delete/view buttons.

methods.name: construct
methods.description: Constructor for F.Editing, initializes configuration and callbacks.

methods.name: preinit
methods.description: Checks and applies data and options before UI creation.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the editing component and creates UI.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes the editing UI and cleans up.

methods.name: $create
methods.description: Creates the editing UI elements and buttons.

methods.name: $rowButtons
methods.description: Creates the container with row action buttons.

methods.name: _onEditClick
methods.description: Handles edit button click, triggers edit callback.

methods.name: _onDeleteClick
methods.description: Handles delete button click, triggers delete callback.

methods.name: _onViewClick
methods.description: Handles view button click, triggers view callback.

methods.name: _onAddClick
methods.description: Handles add button click, triggers add callback.

methods.name: _onShowClick
methods.description: Handles show button click, shows editing UI.

methods.name: _onHideClick
methods.description: Handles hide button click, hides editing UI.
